title: Dermal fillers in Cairo
description: Explore dermal fillers for cheeks, lips, jawline and under-eye hollows in Cairo, including how the area, previous filler and medical risks guide your plan.
answer: Dermal filler adds volume or changes contours in selected areas such as the cheeks, jawline or lips. At {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin, adults can have their facial proportions and previous treatments assessed. Under-eye filler needs particular care because shadows, puffiness and true volume loss need different approaches.
preparation: We assess the area, review your medical history and ask about any previous filler.
howPerformed: Hyaluronic acid fillers are gels placed beneath the skin to add volume or adjust contours. Areas may include the lips, cheeks, chin, jawline, folds beside the mouth and hollows under the eyes. Suitability varies by area and anatomy.
followup: Swelling, tenderness and bruising can last several days, particularly around the lips. We will explain aftercare and the symptoms that need prompt medical attention. Contact us if you have concerns during recovery.
suitability: Fillers may suit adults who want to address volume loss or adjust a facial contour. Your consultation helps us decide whether filler is appropriate and discuss other options when needed.
outlook: You may see a change straight away, but swelling can affect the early result. We usually review once it has settled, often around two weeks. Results may last six to eighteen months, depending on the product, area and individual response.

faqs.q: Will my lips or face look overdone?
faqs.a: Tell us how much change you want. We plan the amount around your features and can take a gradual approach, reviewing the result before considering more treatment.

Fillers carry risks, including swelling, bruising and, rarely, blocked blood vessels that can cause serious harm. We discuss these before treatment and explain what to do if symptoms occur. Some hyaluronic acid fillers can be dissolved, but this does not remove all treatment risks.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Botox and filler?
faqs.a: Botox relaxes muscles that create expression lines. Filler adds volume or changes a contour. We will explain which, if either, is suitable for your concern.
Discomfort varies with the area and method. Describe any previous sensitivity so that suitable comfort measures and pauses can be discussed.
